description: Validates an Italian Partita IVA (VAT number: 11 digits + Luhn checksum; accepts the IT prefix). Formal check only: it does NOT say whether the VAT number is active or ceased (the limit is stated in the response, in `non_verificato`). For a VAT number of another EU country use `verify_payee` (VIES). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

partita_iva.description: The Partita IVA to validate: 11 digits, with or without the IT prefix (e.g. 12345678903 or IT12345678903).

vat_number.description: Alias of `partita_iva` (Italian VAT number): the same value, accepted because other tools of this server use this name. If you send both names, the values must match.

name: validate_partita_iva
title: Validate Partita IVA
